_comment: Starter task set for stage 0 ONLY. These are placeholders whose job is to
exercise the harness across a handful of distinct rollouts.
Stage 1 replaces this file with mined issue/PR pairs: unshallow the clone,
walk closed issues that have a merged PR, and emit one task per pair with
the issue body as the prompt and the merged diff plus that PR's tests as
ground truth. Do not run stage 2 against these placeholders.
SANDBOX: `repo` must point at a throwaway. A real rollout of
github-issue-crusher pushes branches and opens pull requests.

tasks.prompt: Issue: a user-visible string in the settings panel is hard-coded instead of going through useT(). Add the key to en.ts and every locale chunk, and replace the literal.
Issue: cargo clippy reports a needless_borrow in the cron domain. Fix the borrow and keep the tests green.
Issue: a relative link in gitbooks/developing/architecture.md points at a file that has moved. Repoint it.
Issue: a Redux selector throws when the thread slice is empty on first boot. Guard the access and add a unit test.
Issue: .env.example is missing a variable the core now reads at startup. Document it with a sensible default.
Issue: a Vitest spec asserts on a real timer and fails intermittently in CI. Make it deterministic with fake timers.
